title: Wasted Time
statementMd:
Mr. Scrooge, a very busy man, decided to count the time he wastes on all sorts of useless stuff to evaluate the lost profit. He has already counted the time he wastes sleeping and eating. And now Mr. Scrooge wants to count the time he has wasted signing papers.

Mr. Scrooge's signature can be represented as a polyline $*A*_{1}*A*_{2}... *A*_{*n*}$. Scrooge signs like that: first it places a pen at the point $*A*_{1}$, then draws a segment from point $*A*_{1}$ to point $*A*_{2}$, then he draws a segment from point $*A*_{2}$ to point $*A*_{3}$ and so on to point $*A*_{*n*}$, where he stops signing and takes the pen off the paper. At that the resulting line can intersect with itself and partially repeat itself but Scrooge pays no attention to it and never changes his signing style. As Scrooge makes the signature, he never takes the pen off the paper and his writing speed is constant — $50$ millimeters per second.

Scrooge signed exactly $*k*$ papers throughout his life and all those signatures look the same.

Find the total time Scrooge wasted signing the papers.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 1000$). Each of the following $*n*$ lines contains the coordinates of the polyline's endpoints. The $*i*$-th one contains coordinates of the point $*A*_{*i*}$ — integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$, separated by a space.

All points $*A*_{*i*}$ are different. The absolute value of all coordinates does not exceed $20$. The coordinates are measured in millimeters.

## Output

Print one real number — the total time Scrooges wastes on signing the papers in seconds. The absolute or relative error should not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.
statementZhMd:
斯克鲁奇先生是一个非常忙碌的人，他决定计算自己在各种无用事情上浪费的时间，以评估因此损失的利润。他已经计算过睡觉和吃饭所浪费的时间。现在，斯克鲁奇先生想计算自己签署文件所浪费的时间。

斯克鲁奇先生的签名可以表示为一条折线 $*A*_{1}*A*_{2}... *A*_{*n*}$。斯克鲁奇按照如下方式签名：首先，他将笔放在点 $*A*_{1}$ 上，然后从点 $*A*_{1}$ 向点 $*A*_{2}$ 画一条线段，接着从点 $*A*_{2}$ 向点 $*A*_{3}$ 画一条线段，如此继续，直到点 $*A*_{*n*}$，此时他完成签名并将笔从纸上拿开。在此过程中，最终得到的线条可能与自身相交，也可能有部分重复，但斯克鲁奇对此毫不在意，也从不改变自己的签名方式。签名时，斯克鲁奇从不将笔从纸上拿开，并且书写速度恒定，为每秒 $50$ 毫米。

斯克鲁奇一生中恰好签署了 $*k*$ 份文件，并且所有签名看起来都一样。

请计算斯克鲁奇在签署这些文件时总共浪费的时间。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 1000$）。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含折线端点的坐标。第 $*i*$ 行包含点 $*A*_{*i*}$ 的坐标——两个由空格分隔的整数 $x*_{*i*}$ 和 $y*_{*i*}$。

所有点 $*A*_{*i*}$ 均不相同。所有坐标的绝对值不超过 $20$。坐标的单位为毫米。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数——斯克鲁奇签署这些文件所浪费的总时间，单位为秒。绝对误差或相对误差不应超过 $10^{ - 6}$。
